description_en: Invoke QueryAdvancedDomainList to perform an advanced search of the domain name list
description_zh: 调用QueryAdvancedDomainList高级搜索域名列表
kebab_example: aliyun domain query-advanced-domain-list --end-expiration-date 1522080000000 --user-client-ip 127.0.0.1 --lang en --start-expiration-date 1522080000000 --product-domain-type gTLD --page-num 1 --page-size 10 --domain-group-id -1 --domain-name-sort false --domain-status 1 --end-length 5 --excluded test --excluded-prefix false --excluded-suffix false --expiration-date-sort false --form 12 --key-word test --key-word-prefix false --key-word-suffix true --product-domain-type-sort false --registration-date-sort false --start-length 5 --trade-type -1 --suffixs com.cn --start-registration-date 1522080000000 --end-registration-date 1522080000000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmw6bpc6n7zai --tag Value=废弃 Key=数智 --is-premium-domain false --api-version 2018-01-29 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryAdvancedDomainList

parameters.help_en: End time for expiration date range query, represented as the number of milliseconds since 00:00:00 UTC on January 1, 1970.

parameters.help_en: User IP address

parameters.help_en:
The language of error messages returned by the API. Valid values:
zh: Chinese.
en: English.

parameters.help_en:
Domain name type. Valid values:
New gTLD (new top-level domain).
gTLD (generic top-level domain).
ccTLD (country code top-level domain).
other (other top-level domains not listed above)

域名类型。取值：
New gTLD（新顶级域名）。

other（除上述类型之外的其他顶级域名）
